ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida PsExec-driven mass deployment culminating in .rhysida file writes / CriticalBreachDetected.pdf ransom note
ucs.description: Hunts Rhysida's signature endgame: PSEXESVC service install fan-out across the estate from a single staging host, followed within minutes by file writes carrying the .rhysida extension or the CriticalBreachDetected.pdf ransom note drop. This combination (T1569.002 + T1486) is the deterministic tail of every Rhysida intrusion observed by CISA/FBI #StopRansomware AA23-319A and Microsoft's tracking of the actor under cluster Storm-1567 / Vanilla Tempest co-deployments.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent dc(Processes.dest) as host_count values(Processes.dest) as hosts from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="PSEXESVC.exe" OR Processes.process="*\\PSEXESVC.exe*" OR Processes.process="*-accepteula*-s*cmd*") by Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where host_count >= 3 | join type=inner user [| tstats summariesonly=t count values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_paths values(Filesystem.file_name) as files dc(Filesystem.dest) as encrypt_hosts from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida" OR Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.pdf" OR Filesystem.file_name="*CriticalBreach*") by Filesystem.user _time span=30m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where encrypt_hosts >= 1] | eval rhysida_confidence=if(encrypt_hosts>0 AND host_count>=3,"high","medium") | table first_seen last_seen user parent host_count hosts encrypt_hosts files file_paths rhysida_confidence | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let PsExecFanOut = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "PSEXESVC.exe"
        or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "PSEXESVC.exe"
        or (FileName =~ "psexec.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-accepteula","\\\\","-s cmd","-r"))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize StagingHosts = dcount(InitiatingProcessAccountName),
                VictimHosts  = dcount(DeviceName),
                FirstSvc     = min(Timestamp),
                LastSvc      = max(Timestamp),
                AnyCmd       = any(ProcessCommandLine)
              by InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
    | where VictimHosts >= 3;
let RhysidaArtifacts = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where FileName endswith ".rhysida"
        or FileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"
        or FileName matches regex @"(?i)CriticalBreach.*\.(pdf|txt)$"
    | summarize EncryptHosts = dcount(DeviceName),
                FirstArtifact = min(Timestamp),
                SampleFile = any(FolderPath),
                Writer = any(InitiatingProcessFileName)
              by InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes);
PsExecFanOut
| join kind=inner RhysidaArtifacts
    on InitiatingProcessAccountName
| where FirstArtifact between (FirstSvc .. LastSvc + 2h)
| project FirstSvc, FirstArtifact,
          DwellMin = datetime_diff('minute', FirstArtifact, FirstSvc),
          Actor = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          VictimHosts, EncryptHosts,
          PsExecCmd = AnyCmd, Writer, SampleFile
| order by FirstArtifact desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let PsExecFanOut = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\PSEXESVC.exe"
        or (NewProcessName endswith "\\psexec.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("-accepteula","\\\\","-s cmd"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | summarize VictimHosts = dcount(Computer),
                FirstSvc = min(TimeGenerated),
                LastSvc  = max(TimeGenerated),
                AnyCmd   = any(CommandLine)
              by SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
    | where VictimHosts >= 3;
let RhysidaArtifacts = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida"
        or TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"
        or TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)CriticalBreach.*\.(pdf|txt)$"
    | summarize EncryptHosts = dcount(DvcHostname),
                FirstArtifact = min(TimeGenerated),
                SampleFile = any(TargetFilePath)
              by ActorUsername, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes);
PsExecFanOut
| join kind=inner (RhysidaArtifacts | project-rename SubjectUserName = ActorUsername) on SubjectUserName
| where FirstArtifact between (FirstSvc .. LastSvc + 2h)
| project FirstSvc, FirstArtifact,
          DwellMin = datetime_diff('minute', FirstArtifact, FirstSvc),
          Actor = SubjectUserName,
          VictimHosts, EncryptHosts,
          PsExecCmd = AnyCmd, SampleFile
| order by FirstArtifact desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida Ransomware - PsExec Fan-Out and .rhysida Extension Writes
id: 6f1c3a9c-8f7d-4b2e-9b1e-c0d3a7b8e1d2
status: experimental
description: Detects file-system writes producing the .rhysida ransomware extension or the CriticalBreachDetected.pdf ransom note, the deterministic terminal stage of a Rhysida intrusion.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1569.002
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  rhysida_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.rhysida'
  ransom_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - 'CriticalBreachDetected.pdf'
      - 'CriticalBreachDetected.txt'
  condition: rhysida_ext or ransom_note
fields:
  - Image
  - TargetFilename
  - User
  - ComputerName
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IR / tabletop drills that simulate Rhysida artifacts.
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*.rhysida OR *.RHYSIDA OR *\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf OR *\CRITICALBREACHDETECTED.PDF OR *\CriticalBreachDetected.txt) OR (@Image:(*\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\psexesvc.exe OR *\PSEXESVC.EXE) AND @TargetFilename:(*.rhysida OR *\Users\Public\*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\.rhysida$/i OR TargetFileName=/CriticalBreachDetected\.(pdf|txt)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=writes), min(_time, as=first_seen), max(_time, as=last_seen), collect([TargetFileName], multival=true)])
| writes > 1
| sort(first_seen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida SILENTKILL/g.bat pre-encryption cleanup chain (shadow-copy purge + Defender disable + log wipe)
ucs.description: Hunts the batch/PowerShell cleanup tooling Rhysida operators run on each victim host minutes before invoking the encryptor: vssadmin/wbadmin shadow deletion, wevtutil mass log clearing, Set-MpPreference Defender disablement, and bcdedit safeboot tampering — issued as a tight burst from a single InitiatingProcess (typically cmd.exe spawned by PSEXESVC or a renamed g.bat). The exact ordering is documented in Sophos/SentinelOne Rhysida IR reports.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as actions values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wevtutil.exe","bcdedit.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*cl Security*" OR Processes.process="*cl System*" OR Processes.process="*cl Application*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*Add-MpPreference*ExclusionPath*" OR Processes.process="*stop Sense*" OR Processes.process="*stop WinDefend*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval is_vss=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)delete\s+shadows"),1,0), is_logwipe=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)wevtutil\s+cl"),1,0), is_defender=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)(DisableRealtimeMonitoring|stop\s+(Sense|WinDefend))"),1,0), is_safeboot=if(match(cmdlines,"(?i)(safeboot|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)"),1,0) | eval rhysida_score = is_vss + is_logwipe + is_defender + is_safeboot | where rhysida_score >= 3 | table first_seen last_seen dest user parents rhysida_score is_vss is_logwipe is_defender is_safeboot cmdlines | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let BurstWindow = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wevtutil.exe","bcdedit.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","sc.exe")
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend IsVssDelete    = iff(Cmd matches regex @"delete\s+shadows" or Cmd matches regex @"delete\s+catalog", 1, 0)
| extend IsLogClear     = iff(Cmd matches regex @"wevtutil\s+cl\s+" or Cmd has "clear-eventlog", 1, 0)
| extend IsDefenderOff  = iff(Cmd has_any ("disablerealtimemonitoring","mppreference -disable","add-mppreference -exclusionpath","stop windefend","stop sense","sc.exe stop sense"), 1, 0)
| extend IsRecoveryOff  = iff(Cmd has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), 1, 0)
| where IsVssDelete + IsLogClear + IsDefenderOff + IsRecoveryOff >= 1
| summarize VssDel    = max(IsVssDelete),
            LogWipe   = max(IsLogClear),
            DefOff    = max(IsDefenderOff),
            RecOff    = max(IsRecoveryOff),
            FirstHit  = min(Timestamp),
            LastHit   = max(Timestamp),
            Cmds      = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Parents   = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, BurstWindow)
| extend RhysidaScore = VssDel + LogWipe + DefOff + RecOff
| where RhysidaScore >= 3
| extend PsExecParent = iff(Parents has_any (dynamic(["psexesvc.exe","psexec.exe"])), "yes", "no")
| project FirstHit, LastHit, DeviceName, AccountName, RhysidaScore, VssDel, LogWipe, DefOff, RecOff, PsExecParent, Parents, Cmds
| order by FirstHit desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let BurstWindow = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" or Img endswith "\\wbadmin.exe"
    or Img endswith "\\wevtutil.exe" or Img endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    or Img endswith "\\powershell.exe" or Img endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
    or Img endswith "\\sc.exe" or Img endswith "\\net.exe"
| extend IsVssDelete    = iff(Cmd matches regex @"delete\s+shadows" or Cmd matches regex @"delete\s+catalog", 1, 0)
| extend IsLogClear     = iff(Cmd matches regex @"wevtutil\s+cl\s+" or Cmd has "clear-eventlog", 1, 0)
| extend IsDefenderOff  = iff(Cmd has_any ("disablerealtimemonitoring","add-mppreference -exclusionpath","stop windefend","stop sense"), 1, 0)
| extend IsRecoveryOff  = iff(Cmd has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), 1, 0)
| where IsVssDelete + IsLogClear + IsDefenderOff + IsRecoveryOff >= 1
| summarize VssDel = max(IsVssDelete), LogWipe = max(IsLogClear),
            DefOff = max(IsDefenderOff), RecOff = max(IsRecoveryOff),
            FirstHit = min(TimeGenerated), LastHit = max(TimeGenerated),
            Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5)
          by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, BurstWindow)
| extend RhysidaScore = VssDel + LogWipe + DefOff + RecOff
| where RhysidaScore >= 3
| extend PsExecParent = iff(tostring(Parents) has_any ("psexesvc.exe","psexec.exe"), "yes", "no")
| project FirstHit, LastHit, Computer, SubjectUserName, RhysidaScore, VssDel, LogWipe, DefOff, RecOff, PsExecParent, Parents, Cmds
| order by FirstHit desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@CommandLine:(*delete\ shadows* OR *DELETE\ SHADOWS* OR *delete\ catalog* OR *DELETE\ CATALOG*) OR @CommandLine:(*wevtutil\ cl* OR *WEVTUTIL\ CL* OR *Clear-EventLog* OR *clear-eventlog*) OR @CommandLine:(*DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR *disablerealtimemonitoring* OR *Add-MpPreference\ -ExclusionPath* OR *stop\ WinDefend* OR *stop\ Sense*) OR @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT* OR *recoveryenabled\ no* OR *bootstatuspolicy\ ignoreallfailures*)) @ParentImage:(*\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\psexesvc.exe OR *\PSEXESVC.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE)
